val get_physical_device_cooperative_matrix_properties : Vulkan_types.vk_instance Ctypes.structure Ctypes_static.ptr -> (Vulkan_types.vk_physical_device Ctypes.structure Ctypes_static.ptr -> Unsigned.uint32 Ctypes_static.ptr -> Vulkan_types.vk_cooperative_matrix_properties Ctypes.structure Ctypes_static.ptr -> Vulkan_types.vk_result) option

vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR, resolved through vkGetInstanceProcAddr rather than dlsym.

Not a stylistic choice. Measured on this workstation: dlsym on libvulkan.so.1 (Arch vulkan-icd-loader, loader for Mesa 26.1.4-arch3.1) fails with "undefined symbol: vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR" — the Khronos loader exports core and promoted entry points as symbols but not every extension one, so a foreign_vk_lazy binding for this function would raise Dl.DL_error the first time it was forced. vkGetInstanceProcAddr returns a valid pointer for the same name on the same loader.

Returns None when the loader does not know the name, which is the honest answer for a build against a loader too old to have heard of the extension. A None here becomes an unprobed device, hence Unknown, hence refused.
